rules.title: Statewide limitations on gross rental rate increases to address rent gouging
rules.requirement: This section establishes statewide limitations on gross rental rate increases to address rent gouging during the current housing crisis. It applies only for the limited time needed to address the crisis and does not expand or limit local government authority consistent with Chapter 2.7 (commencing with Section 1954.50).
rules.summary_plain: California limits how much rent can be increased statewide to prevent rent gouging during the housing crisis, effective April 1, 2024, through January 1, 2030.
rules.summary_plain_es: California limita cuánto se puede aumentar la renta a nivel estatal para prevenir aumentos excesivos durante la crisis de vivienda, vigente del 1 de abril de 2024 al 1 de enero de 2030.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies statewide to rental units subject to rent increase regulations under Chapter 2.7 (commencing with Section 1954.50).
rules.exemptions_text: This section does not authorize local governments to establish rent increase limits beyond those permissible under Chapter 2.7, nor does it affect local rent or price control authority consistent with that chapter.
rules.quoted_span: The Legislature finds and declares that the unique circumstances of the current housing crisis require a statewide response to address rent gouging by establishing statewide limitations on gross rental rate increases.
rules.preempts_note: This section does not limit local governments from adopting or maintaining rent controls consistent with Chapter 2.7.
